sentences.text: Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions
**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to promote youth participation in adventure sports by providing financial assistance for training, workshops, and competitions.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Sports & Culture; Sector: Sports

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain &amp; Sea Adventure Sports Competitions&quot; by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote adventure sports among the youth of Gujarat by encouraging their participation in training programs, workshops, expeditions, and competitions organized within and outside the state. The scheme offers financial support to cover expenses such as fees, equipment, insurance, transportation, and other relevant costs.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹30,000/- or 75% of the actual expenditure (whichever is lower).

Application Process: Step 1: The interested applicant should download the prescribed format of the [application form](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/ViewForm.aspx). Step 2: In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the below mentioned address. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. > Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department > Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities, Gujarat State, Block: 11, Third Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, Sector-10, > Gandhinagar, 382010. > Mobile: 079-23254095, 079-23252995 > Mail: commi-synca[at]gujarat[dot]gov[dot]in > Website: http://sycd.gujarat.gov.in
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department
**Tags:** Adventure Sports, Financial Assistance, Youth Empowerment, Training Camps
